title: Apple adds steps before another company’s agent can control a Mac
summary: Mark Gurman reports that enabling ChatGPT’s computer control takes 14 steps in macOS 27.3, up from four.

topics.angle: An operating system’s owner deciding whose agent may drive it.
One reason people give for putting another system on a Mac.

claims.text: The count went from four steps to 14.
Apple cites security; some users see anti-competitiveness.
DHH compares it to Apple protecting its 30% cut.

to_find: The 14 steps, counted on a Mac running 27.3
Whether Apple’s own agent needs the same steps
would_change: A count on a real machine that differs, or an Apple change in a later build.
